screen_corners._comment: Three corners of the physical screen in world space (cm). X=right, Y=forward, Z=up. Run touch_test_pygame.py without this key, touch each corner, read world coords, then fill in here.

screen_rect._comment: Legacy axis-aligned rect used by browser games. X=right, Z=up. Keep in sync with screen_corners once calibrated.

detection._comment: Tuned for close-range hand-on-screen. depth_delta_mm must be small enough to catch a hand 1-5cm shallower than the screen background.

camera._comment: Used when running with --camera. Leave serial blank for first detected device.
